# Lightweight deduplicated monthly fallback pulse for Slot 70 (Eurasian Wonders & Orders).
# No-ops immediately if Slot 70 in oe_mainline_lock.txt has already run this calendar month.
# Rebel-guarded per fx17_rebel_guard.py; keeps world line active if BYZ falls or before Slot 70 is wired.
monthly_country_pulse = { on_actions = { oe_wnd_fallback_pulse } }

oe_wnd_fallback_pulse = {
    trigger = {
        is_rebel_country = no
        NOT = { global_var:oe_wnd_ran_m ?= oe_wnd_m_now }
        OR = {
            is_ai = no
            AND = { tag = BYZ is_rebel_country = no }
            AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:BYZ } tag = CHI }
            AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:BYZ } NOT = { country_exists = c:CHI } tag = MOS }
            AND = { NOT = { country_exists = c:BYZ } NOT = { country_exists = c:CHI } NOT = { country_exists = c:MOS } tag = MAM }
        }
    }
    effect = {
        oe_wnd_monthly = yes
    }
}
